units.passage: Generative AI may also generate content that leads to allegations of plagiarism or other forms of academic dishonesty against students who make use of it.
units.why: Warns AI content can lead to 'allegations of plagiarism or other forms of academic dishonesty' against students: unintentional plagiarism risk, P120.

units.passage: Review all material produced for accuracy, violations of copyright protections, and plagiarism.
units.why: "Review all material produced for accuracy, violations of copyright protections, and plagiarism" directs users to check AI output for copyright and plagiarism problems; P120 (unintentional plagiarism) fits best.
units.fit_note: Also covers accuracy review and copyright, not only unintentional plagiarism.

units.passage: Relying solely on an AI-generated summary rather than reading the original source may lead to false claims or citations, both of which constitute plagiarism.
units.why: "Relying solely on an AI-generated summary ... may lead to false claims or citations, both of which constitute plagiarism" warns of unintentional plagiarism (P120).
units.fit_note: Also discourages relying on AI summaries instead of reading the original source.

units.passage: Failing to correct a citation generated by artificial intelligence.
units.why: 'Failing to correct a citation generated by artificial intelligence' is listed as plagiarism, making uncorrected AI citations a violation; P120 (AI output can cause unintentional plagiarism).

units.passage: Using an editor like Grammarly to edit an entire document not realizing that it edited quotes and parapharsed statements making the information an inaccuarate representation of the source material.
units.why: Plagiarism example: an editor edited "quotes and paraphrased statements making the information an inaccuarate representation of the source material" without the student noticing; unintentional plagiarism through AI, P120.

units.passage: Uncited or improperly attributed material used by artificial intelligence algorithms undermines academic integrity and raises ethical concerns regarding the accuracy, creativity, and reliability of generated content.
units.why: The text says 'Uncited or improperly attributed material used by artificial intelligence algorithms undermines academic integrity'; it warns that AI output carries unattributed sources, which is P120.

units.passage: It can also provide inaccurate information, plagiarize sources without citing them, or cause you to to run afoul of the the university's Academic Integrity Policy
units.why: The page says generative AI 'can also provide inaccurate information, plagiarize sources without citing them'; a warning about unattributed sources: P120.

units.passage: Students should also do their due diligence to make sure the AI content they use does not plagiarize or infringe upon the copyrights or privacy of other individuals or content creators.
units.why: Students should make sure AI content 'does not plagiarize or infringe upon the copyrights or privacy of other individuals': P120 (warns of unintentional plagiarism) rather than P52, since plagiarism leads.

units.passage: AI-generated content may include copyrighted material without proper attribution, making it crucial to review and verify all AI-generated outputs before use.
units.why: 'AI-generated content may include copyrighted material without proper attribution, making it crucial to review and verify': unintentional plagiarism, P120.
